name: Italian advance into Egypt: 13–17 September 1940 (linked research)

aim.cw: Delay the Italian advance, preserve the mobile screen, and deny a drive on Mersa Matruh. Defend forward positions only when their value outweighs the risk.
aim.axis: Cross the frontier and secure Sidi Barrani, with the plateau flank covered at Sofafi. Press toward Matruh only if the played force and supply can sustain it.

about: The historical Italian advance began 13 September and reached Sidi Barrani by 16 September. This linked trial allows a different advance or defence; no town changes hands automatically. Five daily turns include the day after the historical halt. The opening roster and exact unit placements remain back-projected estimates from the later Compass research scenario. The map does not model the damaged road or water pipeline that constrained the historical advance.
